summary: Grundy County, TN fire tower (Beersheba/Dykes Mtn) listed as removed. Only a 1955 purchase notice found. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as removed; no source describes the site today.

events.note: Notice that the state had bought twelve 80-foot steel towers and that one was to be erected at this site before early winter; a plan, not a completion record
Not on the list of extant Tennessee fire towers as of March 26, 2014

evidence.supports: state bought 12 80-foot steel towers, one to be erected at this site before early winter
evidence.quote: October 7, 1955: The state purchased 12 80-foot steel lookout towers, one of which is to be erected at this site before early winter at a cost of approximately $36,000. (The News-Democrat)

notes_for_editor: Only history is the 1955 purchase notice reprinted on Forest Lookouts, which describes a tower still to be erected, plus the status word Removed. The record's height_m of 24.4 matches the 80-foot purchase figure and is not a measured height. Searches for a Savage Gulf or Beersheba Springs lookout found nothing. No source describes the site today.
